453:     def execDetails(
454:             self, reqId: int, contract: Contract, execution: Execution):
455:         """
456:         This wrapper handles both live fills and responses to
457:         reqExecutions.
458:         """
459:         self._logger.info(f'execDetails {execution}')
460:         if execution.orderId == UNSET_INTEGER:
461:             # bug in TWS: executions of manual orders have unset value
462:             execution.orderId = 0
463:         trade = self.permId2Trade.get(execution.permId)
464:         if not trade:
465:             key = self.orderKey(
466:                 execution.clientId, execution.orderId, execution.permId)
467:             trade = self.trades.get(key)
468:         if trade and contract == trade.contract:
469:             contract = trade.contract
470:         else:
471:             contract = Contract.create(**dataclassAsDict(contract))
472:         execId = execution.execId
473:         isLive = reqId not in self._futures
474:         time = self.lastTime if isLive else execution.time
475:         fill = Fill(contract, execution, CommissionReport(), time)
476:         if execId not in self.fills:
477:             # first time we see this execution so add it
478:             self.fills[execId] = fill
479:             if trade:
480:                 trade.fills.append(fill)
481:                 logEntry = TradeLogEntry(
482:                     time,
483:                     trade.orderStatus.status,
484:                     f'Fill {execution.shares}@{execution.price}')
485:                 trade.log.append(logEntry)
486:                 if isLive:
487:                     self._logger.info(f'execDetails: {fill}')
488:                     self.ib.execDetailsEvent.emit(trade, fill)
489:                     trade.fillEvent(trade, fill)
490:         if not isLive:
491:             self._results[reqId].append(fill)
